content: Regulator of Chromosome Condensation 1, commonly referred to as RCC1, is a human gene and the protein it encodes. It is also known as Ran guanine nucleotide exchange factor (RanGEF). RCC1 serves as a guanine nucleotide exchange factor specifically for the Ran GTPase, facilitating the exchange of GDP for GTP on Ran. RCC1 has been demonstrated to interact with RanBP3 and Ran, which are proteins involved in biological processes related to Ran signaling.
